summary: Iteration 7 (cross-document material dedup) PASSED end-to-end. Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_iter7_dedup.py (4 tests, 25.28s) covering: (1) first-upload baseline (merged=0/skipped=0/materials_count>0/all dedup_audit decisions='new'), (2) second-upload-of-same-image dedup (count_a=5 -> count_b=5, ratio=1.00, merged=3, growth ratio < 1.6 tolerance), (3) /api/projects/{id}/documents exposes materials_merged/materials_skipped/dedup_audit on done docs, (4) merged quantities sanity (no negatives, valid categories). All 4 tests pass. Backend log line 'Pipeline done for ... materials new=X merged=Y skipped=Z synced=...' verified present after every successful analysis. Frontend: live UI verification on admin's TEST_iter7_ui_dedup project — Doc B card renders '1 NEW' (white) + '+1 MERGED' (orange) + '2 SKIPPED' (gray) + '3D SYNCED' (blue) badges and the 'dedup details' <details> expander; Doc A card legitimately shows only '3 NEW' (no merged/skipped since values are 0). Pre-existing historic admin docs show no merged/skipped badges (expected — they predate the feature).
critical_code_review_comments: GOOD: documents.py:run() pipeline now does in correct order — (1) read existing materials sorted by created_at to build deterministic ref_to_id 1-based index AND fuzzy normalised existing_keys map, (2) inject EXISTING MATERIALS prompt block, (3) per-material branch on dedup tag with proper precedence: skip > merge > new, (4) fuzzy-fallback demotion 'new'->'merge' when _norm_key collides, (5) self-collision guard by inserting just-created keys into existing_keys so multiple new items in same response don't dup against themselves.
GOOD: _norm_key strips non-alphanumerics from name+unit and lowercases category — robust to trivial variations like '2x4 Lumber' vs '2x4_lumber' vs '2X4 LUMBER'.
GOOD: merge path uses $inc:{quantity} + $addToSet:{source_documents} so quantities accumulate and the source_documents array reflects every doc that contributed.
GOOD: Doc record exposes materials_merged/materials_skipped/dedup_audit on the final 'done' status update — frontend reads these directly with no extra round-trip.
GOOD: 3D-sync regression intact — walls/doors/windows still merge into blueprint when doc_type is floor_plan/blueprint/site_plan.

MINOR: dedup_audit can grow unbounded if a project ingests hundreds of docs; consider capping audit array length or only keeping non-'new' entries (the UI already filters to non-'new' via .filter((a)=>a.decision!=='new')). Storage-only concern, not functional.

MINOR: target_id resolution uses int(ref) but if AI returns a stringified number (e.g. '2') the isinstance(ref,(int,float)) check skips fuzzy lookup. Low risk — gpt-4o reliably emits ints — but a try:int(ref) fallback would be more defensive.
MINOR: 'syncing' status only set when (walls or doors or windows) AND doc_type matches; for photos that's fine, just noting the state machine has no explicit 'no-sync' transition. Not a bug.

rca of the issue: N/A — this iteration tested a NEW feature, not a bug. Dedup pipeline works correctly: AI returns dedup=merge with ref index, backend resolves ref via 1-based ref_to_id map and $inc-s quantity into existing material instead of inserting a new row. Fuzzy fallback (normalised name+category+unit) guarantees that even when AI omits the dedup tag, exact-name duplicates are demoted to 'merge'.
